SUBFINDER_RATE_LIMIT.title: SUBFINDER_RATE_LIMIT
SUBFINDER_RATE_LIMIT.description: Maximum number of http requests to send per second.

SUBFINDER_RATE_TIMEOUT.title: SUBFINDER_RATE_TIMEOUT
SUBFINDER_RATE_TIMEOUT.description: Timeout in seconds subfinder uses per host when resolving. Defaults to 30.

TIMEOUT.title: TIMEOUT
TIMEOUT.description: Maximum time in seconds the whole subfinder run may take. Defaults to 600. When exceeded the boefje reports a timeout.
